digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate calibration (E3 counterfactual replay harness)
propositions: Measure how a gate candidate perturbs verdicts of historical plans that already passed and closed cleanly, to enforce R1's false-positive bar before production exposure.

The deterministic half — stratified sample, frozen plan-v3 baseline, over-sampled 50-ticket FP-control pool, clone/strip/manifest/drift-guard replay driver seams, and the pure LLM-free e3_metrics library with golden tests — was built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 and intentionally not landed on main.

The design removes recall contamination via a recall-stripped store clone (deleting *-REVIEW_RESULT.json) and controls baseline drift with a material-fingerprint guard plus a two-tier coarse-sweep-plus-precise-FP-control structure.
The ~450-run live LLM batch replay and its raw_verdicts/transition_matrix/criterion_deltas/fp_control outputs were permanently rejected on cost and never executed.
The batch is superseded by story d8a5 (change #798) whose standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder accumulates the same verdict-perturbation signal from real reviews at $0 marginal LLM cost.

History-mining a baseline is dead because only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 needed after the impact_model_version bump stranded the history; the story was force-closed via operator-approved rescope without a signed attestation.
